caption:
Finding the right skin tones under raw streetlights is always a battle. 

This is a raw monitor grab from last night's shoot—no correction yet, just pure mood. We wanted the shadows to feel heavy, like the city is closing in on him. Sometimes the simplest frame takes the longest to light.

#OdiaCinema #Cinematography #SetLife #VisualStorytelling
